Krownlandia Arts Sampler

Arrange three shapes, tell a story in three shots, or make a miniature sketch. You can sketch, write, or describe your choices aloud. These optional exercises work without the 3D park and do not affect park progress.

  • Arrange three shapes
  • Tell a story in three shots
  • Make a miniature sketch

Arrange three shapes

Inspired by Express Yourself School of Arts, credited to @elizabeths14 in the historical inventory (page 9).

  1. Choose a circle, triangle, or square for each position: left, center, and right.
  2. Choose a color for each shape: rose, gold, or teal. You can use the color names instead of drawing or coloring.
  3. Describe your design from left to right, naming the shape and color each time. Move one shape or change one color, then describe how the arrangement feels different.

In the 3D park, search the Park map for composition studio to find the Express Yourself board.

Tell a story in three shots

Inspired by KROWN Cinema, credited to @laloreto in the historical inventory (page 10).

  1. Wide view: Imagine a visitor approaching a park path. Describe what tells us where they are.
  2. Detail: Pick one small thing they notice. Describe its shape, sound, or texture.
  3. Closing view: Show or describe what the visitor does next. Read the three shots in order. Would swapping two of them change the story?

In the 3D park, the Library of Alexandria reading desk has a KROWN Cinema · storyboard section with a different three-shot example.

Make a miniature sketch

Inspired by Krownlandia Sketchpad (Art School), credited to @michaelnottoli in the historical inventory (page 13). This nine-square exercise is a prototype interpretation; the art school has not been built.

On paper or aloud, imagine three rows of three squares. Mark the top center, all three middle squares, and the bottom center to make a cross. Change two marks to create your own pattern, then describe it row by row.
